sources.snippet: I2V noise and color shifting generally improved, but motion is a bit overexaggerated. V5: Improved overexaggeration of I2V model. euler_a/beta recommended. V6: New merging structure and overall significantly improved quality. I2V noise for the first 1-2 frames still exists, but it clears up much better than previous versions.

sources.title: GitHub - Wan-Video/Wan2.2: Wan: Open and Advanced Large-Scale Video ...
sources.snippet: 👍 Efficient High-Definition Hybrid TI2V: Wan2.2 open-sources a 5B model built with our advanced Wan2.2-VAE that achieves a compression ratio of 16×16×4. This model supports both text-to-video and image-to-video generation at 720P resolution with 24fps and can also run on consumer-grade graphics cards like 4090.

sources.title: 万相视频2.2的替代品WAN2.2-14B-Rapid-AllInOne，实测
sources.snippet: 分享两个模型：作者：Phr00t；项目名称：WAN2.2-14B-Rapid-AllInOne 主要作用就是将万相视频中的流程简化，只需在checkpoints加载模型即可实现文生视频、图生视频功能。 到底实际表现如何，我给大家实测了一下。
